newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron rises in early trade on H1 net.
newsitem.headline: Petron rises in early trade on H1 net.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp's shares rose 30 centavos, or 4.92 percent, to 6.40 pesos in early Wednesday trade as investors expressed satisfaction on the company's first half net income, brokers said.
Petron reported on Tuesday that its net income for the first six months of the year rose by 13 percent to 2.25 billion pesos.
"Petron's first quarter net income was poor but the second quarter was strong. It was a welcome development," said Bing Trinidad, sales manager at DBS Securities.

"The higher net income for the first half of this year showed that Petron was doing better in the second quarter what with double digit gasoline sales growth rate," said Spencer Yap, analyst at BPI Securities Corp.
Petron was the third most actively traded issue early in the session with turnover at 41.94 million pesos.
